decisions.rationale: Public knowledge snippets do not provide sufficient evidence to establish a direct relation between Type B lactic acidosis secondary to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and mesenteric lymphoma.

option_relations.rationale: Small bowel ischemia due to mesenteric lymphoma is a specific instance of mesenteric lymphoma
Mesenteric lymphoma with bowel ischemia is equivalent to the leaf disease mesenteric lymphoma
Type B lactic acidosis secondary to diffuse large B-cell lymphoma is related to mesenteric lymphoma, but the relation is not direct
Non-Hodgkin lymphoma is a broader class containing mesenteric lymphoma
